embeddedSignup.title: Connect WhatsApp Business
embeddedSignup.subtitle: Connect your WhatsApp number officially through Meta, without taking it off the WhatsApp Business app.
embeddedSignup.intro: The connection runs inside Meta's own dialog. We never see your password, and Meta decides whether the number is eligible to run alongside the WhatsApp Business app.
embeddedSignup.disconnectNote: Disconnecting only stops this ERP from using the number. Your WhatsApp account on Meta is untouched, the number is not removed from the WhatsApp Business app, and you can reconnect at any time.

embeddedSignup.sdkBlocked: The Facebook SDK could not load. An ad blocker or browser extension is most likely blocking connect.facebook.net — disable it or try a private window.
embeddedSignup.subscribed: App re-subscribed to the account's events
embeddedSignup.nameNotApproved: Meta has not approved the display name yet, so customers see the number instead. It is approved automatically when the number reaches a higher messaging limit.
embeddedSignup.limitExplainer: Messaging limit = how many customers you can send templates to per 24h (250 → 2,000 → 10,000 → 100,000 → unlimited). It rises with business verification or high-quality template sends to distinct customers.

teach.name: Rule name

teach.suggestionsThin: Not enough conversation history yet ({{count}} messages). Come back in a while.
teach.testSubtitle: Type a message the way a customer would, and see which rule fires.
teach.testPlaceholder: e.g. Do you ship to Sinai?
teach.testNoMatch: No fixed answer fires on this. The agent answers itself, carrying {{count}} of your facts.
teach.note: A fixed answer is sent verbatim and takes precedence over any automatic reply. Facts are used in the agent's own words. Either way, price and availability still come from stock — nothing written here can change them.
